accuracy: Names, descriptions and grades follow the PS5 list as reproduced by PowerPyx, GTABase, Insider Gaming and RadioTimes, who agree on all 55. No Rockstar or PlayStation trophy table was published to check against directly. Where guides disagree, the guide text says so and labels the method confirmed, reported, disputed or unconfirmed.
list: Official PS5 trophy list, 55 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze; 28 hidden, 27 visible; 0 online trophies.
namingNote: PlayStation lists one trophy name with asterisks, T**s Ass Drug Money. The 'name' field keeps that exact spelling so it matches the official list; 'displayName' gives the uncensored spelling used by some guides.

trophies.guide: There is no separate task behind this one: it pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. No online play, DLC or difficulty setting is attached to it. In practice it usually arrives right after A Long Road or the last cleanup trophy, whichever you finish last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The 100% checklist only appears after the story, at Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but everything you did during the story already counts toward it. It is forgiving: most lines ask for only part of a total, such as 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts and 15 of 18 meditations. Only a few lines demand everything: all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, the underwater discoveries, every shooting-range gold medal, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Budget roughly 100 of the ~200 total hours for this one; it is the longest trophy by far.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Finish the last story mission, the Chapter 5 finale, and this pops. Wording note: most guides print the description as 'Complete the final mission.', while Insider Gaming and a few others word it 'Complete Chapter 5'; either way it is the same story finish. Ignore one PowerPyx note that ties this trophy to a Chapter 4 mission: that is a copy-paste error in their guide, contradicted by their own list, since the story runs to Chapter 5.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the game's 397 stunts count, in any mix. There are four types: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base-jump parachute challenges. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to build the number, and the optional challenge shown on each stunt icon is not required: performing the stunt once counts. The 100% checklist later wants 300, so keep going past this one. Track progress at Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals are needed in all 42 challenges across the 12 shooting ranges, and the ranges stay open after the story. Treat this as a post-story grind alongside the 100% checklist, which also demands every range gold. Range practice also raises the Focus stat, which helps with Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Vault robberies open through the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…': tail a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so bring your partner and hand over a bag. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and then swap vehicles to break recognition. Each vault can pay up to $205,000. Only 5 of 8 vaults are needed here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way there. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain questlines count toward the 8: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed counters. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count, even though they have their own trophies. Which other strands count was still being confirmed when this guide was written, so watch the trophy's own progress counter in the PS5 trophy list as you finish strands. None of these strands are needed for 100% completion.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Pick any 3 of the 18 card sets; there is no need to finish all of them. Progress per set is shown in the Collections section of the Progress menu. Cards are a natural pick-up-while-exploring collectible, so fold them into runs where you unfog the map.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: 'WAiNK It' means scanning with the WAiNK phone app: hold Up on the D-pad, then R1, and scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags. Any 100 scans count, and the 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this pops during that grind. Scanning is also how vehicles are discovered, so this progresses together with Whip It Good.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: it pops after the opening mission, the first main mission of Chapter 1. Nothing to prepare; just play the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: It pops after playing the first mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?', not at the Chapter 1 end cutscene, so a delayed pop is normal. One warning belongs here even though it is about another trophy: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude), because that one spot may be missable.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Pops as Chapter 3 begins, after the 'Welcome to Vice City' mission. After Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break' mission, Jason and Lucia can be played together, which unlocks the partner trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.nameNote: Most outlets censor this name as T**s Ass Drug Money; GamesFuze prints it in full. The official list uses the asterisked spelling, shown here as the trophy name.

trophies.guide: Pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. Chapter 3 is where several systems unlock (the Key Cloner, Yasmani's jewelry jobs, Andy's questline), so it is a good moment to start side content.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Pops after the final Chapter 4 main mission, 'Starting From Zero'. Chapter 4 is where bank-vault robberies open up (see Maximum Withdrawal), so the endgame money loop starts here.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Just play the Chapter 2 mission of the same name; no special approach is needed. No trophy depends on how a mission is played, since there are no gold medals for missions.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 3 heist mission; the trophy pops on completion. Do not confuse it with Maximum Withdrawal, which is about open-world bank vaults, not this story heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission of the same name; nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission 'Headliners'; the trophy pops on completion.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission 'VCIA Takedown'; the trophy pops on completion. VCIA, the airport, is also the location for Catch Me If You Can, but that is a different trophy with a different task.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 5 mission 'Operation Savage Glory'; the trophy pops on completion. This confirms the story runs into Chapter 5, which is why the wording dispute on You Gotta Know When to Get Off matters.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), playing a video or arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race), and performing a stunt. Check what is left at Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most types are introduced automatically by the story, so this pops naturally while working on other trophies; do not grind it separately.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one drone race at each of the 14 locations; 42 races exist in total. The 100% checklist wants all 42 races, so finish each location fully while you are there instead of coming back. Drone-race wins also count toward the 'win a race' activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: 40 different races exist, and winning the same race twice does not count twice. Spread wins across race types: car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races, since drone wins double-count toward Top Fun. Track which races are already won before repeating one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui'; afterwards he texts a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Play through his fishing quests until the challenge against him unlocks, then beat him in it. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Four games exist under 'Video Games' in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all on the TV at home, plus Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets around Leonida. 'Complete' means finishing all levels of one game once; beating every challenge inside it is not required. Home-TV games can be done as early as Chapter 1, though they are temporarily unavailable during some story sections.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: A Lucia-only questline starting in Chapter 3, when Andy calls or texts her an address in Belville. Five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass, which awards the trophy. Andy does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks, so keep the two systems separate.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's line starts in Chapter 1 at the green 'KR' icon in Key Lento, after the mission 'Island Dreams': he hires you to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor, then bring it back. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 can speed this up. Track progress at Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Starts at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break'. Five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, then Hometown Heroes, which awards the trophy. Billy does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Unlocks after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS', which also unlocks the Key Cloner. Randy then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage at the green 'RK' icon in west Vice City. Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check whether a car is on his list; cars he marks appear in fixed locations, but street cars count too. The best hunting ground is Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, where sports cars park outside hotels or cruise around; deliver in good condition for more pay. The Zorrusso from the story mission counts as the first delivery.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: A Jason-only questline starting after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty'; purple markers show Synthetic Labs around Vice City. The first quest is 'Take Out Kitty Litter', destroying the labs; after enough are destroyed, the second quest 'Spin On This', shutting down the labs, awards the trophy. Tyrone does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice, and the final one needs both characters together, which is possible after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'. Track progress at Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE, the only trophy flagged so: after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and a prompt offers 'Accept'. Do it; the spot is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe and keep a Chapter 1 save. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this warning is trophy-specific.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable, unconfirmed: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation may be required. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: A Jason-only questline. Bret texts Jason after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', starting with 'Veteran Hunted' in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason. Bret gives the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' on the first quest, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. UNCONFIRMED: which exact animal triggers the trophy is still being confirmed by both main guides. The 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so it should pop during that grind.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: 80 challenges exist and only 50 are needed here; the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops automatically on the way to A Long Road. Track them at Progress, Challenges, where finished ones get a tick. Many complete passively while chasing other trophies. Leave this for late cleanup, then pick the easiest remaining challenges; 10 can be skipped entirely.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Only possible after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', when Jason and Lucia can be together; call your partner with hold-Right on the D-pad plus Triangle. Cause chaos until the wanted level hits 4 stars, then escape: the trophy counts once you are out of the red 'heat' zone, not just out of the flashing search area. The easiest escape reported is driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see in. It often pops on its own during bank-vault robberies, which always give 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', when partner free-roam unlocks. Bring your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets, shown with green map icons, while staying wanted, flashing red and blue, the whole time. Go in with body armour, sticky bombs and healing items; rob a couple of items per shop and ideally break the back-room safe. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'. The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app, hold Up then R1; driving them is not needed, since standing by a busy road and scanning passing traffic works. 557 vehicles exist at launch, cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so this pops during that grind. Check discovered totals at Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 plus R3 while aiming: it slows time and drains the purple focus bar at the top left, under health and stamina. Fill Focus first, by eating and drinking, washing up at home, or using Adrenaline to extend it, and use an assault rifle, since the window only lasts a few seconds. Line up 5 enemies before activating it; gang-operation thugs work well. It reportedly does not work on soldiers, police or civilians, so do not farm it on them. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet that is docked to a departure terminal's boarding bridge; planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest are gates E3 and E4: drive through an airfield fence, use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge, or walk in through the terminal, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse out and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport before the trophy fires; the pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a riddle: it never says 'tank'. Steal a military tank, a Rhino, from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; tanks sit at the south end of the base. Enter through the gate, or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot enemies from inside until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs': it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently opening alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry-store robberies, shown with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun; kicking it in sets off the alarm. Find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. A good location is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City. The trophy fires shortly after leaving the store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The easiest route is the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…': tailing the armored truck to a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck, then escape the red heat zone or use a Pay 'n' Spray. The earlier method is to box in a roaming armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and escape the heat radius; sticky bombs become available via Yasmani's shop after his quests. All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100% anyway, so this usually pops on its own.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: 'Explore' means fully unfogging the whole map, not just visiting each region: fly a plane over every dark or fogged patch until the entire map is visible. A plane is far faster than driving; work through the map region by region so no corner is missed. Exploring also reveals stunt spots, race locations and activity icons, so it feeds several other trophies.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: 9 gangs run 39 illegal operations in total, shown with yellow map icons; this trophy needs just 1 operation from each gang. Track per-gang counts at Progress, Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops during that grind. Operations get marked as you go near them, and many are marked automatically through story progress.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: REPORTED METHOD, not confirmed: PowerPyx reports going to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buying an Apple Martini, then drinking it while standing next to the bar. GTABase lists the exact steps as unconfirmed, so treat this as the PowerPyx-reported method, not a confirmed fact. The location is Ocean Beach, Vice City, the same area as the Chapter 4 mission 'Ocean Beach', but this is a separate free-roam task.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: REPORTED METHOD, not confirmed: PowerPyx reports stealing the specific blue 'Banshee' from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and driving it forward straight through the showroom window. The Key Cloner is required first, unlocked in Chapter 3's 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' for Randy; the car cannot be taken before that. Only that blue Banshee counts, not any other car; the pop is slightly delayed and fires after driving away down the street. It is an easter-egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III. GTABase lists the exact steps as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation for the safe. Steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy fires after escaping the police, not when the third item is picked up, and killing the enemies inside is not required. If the mission visit only yields some items, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and grab the rest later; it still counts.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is a riddle: it never mentions strength. The guide consensus, PowerPyx and GTABase, is to max out Strength for BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time; check levels at Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, select a character, Strength, the heart icon. Only possible after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', when switching between characters unlocks. Buy a fitness-club membership and always train together by calling your partner; training one trains the other too. Home workouts become available after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Another riddle description. The guide consensus, PowerPyx and GTABase, is to perform 500 actions that affect the Criminal Profile; the trophy itself shows the running count, x out of 500. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile, so each qualifying action shows a demon-face icon. Profile tiers run Professional, stealthy clean escapes, then Hardened, incapacitating without killing, then Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable. It usually pops passively during other trophies. Avoid Irredeemable: it is permanent and police shoot on sight more often. If it is the last trophy left it can be farmed quickly, but heed the Irredeemable warning first.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED: do not present any method as fact. PowerPyx writes that it is currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner; the store is in Vice City, Little Cuba. GTABase likewise says the exact steps are not confirmed yet. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something. This guide shows it as 'method unconfirmed, check community reports' rather than inventing steps. One weaker source calls it a story trophy; that conflicts with both main guides and is not trusted.
trophies.missableNote: Missability cannot be judged: the method itself is unknown.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: REPORTED METHOD, single detailed source: PowerPyx reports a UFO easter egg on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, while solo. Look for a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods to a UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops an abducted woman: talk to her, offer help, then go back to her car at the roadside. GTABase lists the exact steps as unconfirmed, and GTASix.how cites player videos of the same encounter, so present this as PowerPyx-reported, not confirmed. The encounter can be re-triggered, since it is random, not one-shot.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: DISPUTED METHOD: PowerPyx gives a specific method, riding any bike and kicking 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach. GTABase agrees the description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle, but says the exact steps are unconfirmed. Flag this as disputed, and try the PowerPyx method first. Do not confuse it with Let's Go Bowling, a different trophy with a different task despite the bowling wordplay in both names.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)': it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer needed to launder marked bills. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative, not in one trip. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so the robberies done for 100% usually cover this on their own.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Any spending counts across every shop type, and guns, car mods and tattoos burn through the total fastest. PowerPyx counts 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. Spending done for other trophies, garages, registrations and gear, counts toward this automatically.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which unlocks after Chapter 2's 'Daily Driver'; the total cost is about $160,000. The 4 garages the story gives you do NOT count, only the 8 bought ones. Buying garages also creates the parking space needed for On the Spot, so do this before registering vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app installs after Chapter 2's 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)'; it lets registered stolen vehicles be delivered to your location. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose 'Respray' then 'Register' in his garage; registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes. Early on he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Free garage space is required, so buy the garages for Little Boxes first.
trophies.name: On the Spot
